issues.description: Constructor parameter order is inconsistent with the order required by the problem statement/UML. The statement asks to follow the UML attribute order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), but the solution implements the constructor as (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), which can mislead students and break tests that assume the specified signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution constructor signature (and any dependent tests/usages) to match the UML/spec order: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly match the constructor order intended by the course.
